candidates.summary: the GRC20 cases the ADR cites for its 6M floor run on a two-entry ledger, while the 64-entry avl case already needs 6.22M
candidates.failure_scenario: grc20Realm.Setup (line 163-170) mints to one payer, so the balances tree holds payer and treasury and the allowance tree one key: TransferFrom walks depth-1 trees and costs 5,436,849 gas, admitted at the pinned 6M. The avl paymaster seeded with 64 entries (line 54-59) costs 6,220,498 for the same get/set work. A deployed token with dozens of holders walks a deeper tree, so a chain that sets MaxGasCreditPerTx to the 6M this row pins rejects the motivating paymaster at admission while the test stays green.
candidates.verify_by: In grc20Realm.Setup mint to 64 distinct valid addresses (for example chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/h/"+strconv.Itoa(i))) before the Approve, then from gno.land/: go test -count=1 -run 'TestSponsorshipUseCaseFitsWindow/REAL_grc20_transferFrom' -v ./pkg/gnoland/ ; expect CheckTx to OOG at the 6M window or gasUsed above 6,000,000.

candidates.summary: settlement's bank reads and writes run on an infinite meter, billed to nobody and outside the block gas meter, unlike the ante fee deduction the comment cites as its model
candidates.failure_scenario: A fee-paying tx's DeductFees runs on newCtx (tm2/pkg/sdk/auth/ante.go:250), whose metered meter was set at ante.go:122/124, so its account reads and writes count in GasUsed and in the block gas meter. A sponsored tx's SendCoinsUnrestricted (app.go:309) runs on settleCtx (app.go:276, store.NewInfiniteGasMeter()) after gasUsed was read at :275, so two account reads and two writes per sponsored tx enter neither the realm's charge nor the block gas the EndBlocker prices from. The comment at app.go:270-271 justifies the infinite meter as 'like the ante's fee deduction', which is metered.
candidates.verify_by: sed -n '118,124p;250p' tm2/pkg/sdk/auth/ante.go (SetGasMeter, then DeductFees on newCtx) against app.go:275-276 and :309; then swap settleCtx's meter for store.NewGasMeter(math.MaxInt64) in a scratch tree and log its GasConsumed after a sponsored DeliverTx to size the unbilled work.
candidates.evidence: ante.go:122 'newCtx = SetGasMeter(ctx, consParams.Block.MaxGasCreditPerTx)', :124 'newCtx = SetGasMeter(ctx, tx.Fee.GasWanted)', :250 'res = DeductFees(bank, newCtx, signerAccs[0], ak.FeeCollectorAddress(ctx), std.Coins{tx.Fee.GasFee})'; app.go:275 'gasUsed := ctx.GasMeter().GasConsumed()', :276 'settleCtx := ctx.WithGasMeter(store.NewInfiniteGasMeter())'; head app.go:270-271 comment 'deterministic protocol bookkeeping (like the ante's fee deduction)'.

candidates.summary: a past-chain 0-fee sponsored tx replayed at genesis is re-priced: the realm pays the new chain's gasUsed at the genesis gas price, with no meter limit, not what the source chain charged
candidates.failure_scenario: Genesis replay sets header.Height = metadata.BlockHeight (app.go:964-965), so runTx's `ctx.BlockHeight() > 0` (baseapp.go:1047) marks a replayed 0-fee tx sponsored; with gasReplayMode "source" (app.go:981-982) SetGasMeter returns an infinite meter, PayGas skips SetLimit (paygas.go:55, Limit() is 0), and settlement debits ceil(gasUsed x LastGasPrice at genesis) capped only by MaxFee. Replayed fee-paying txs keep their declared fee, so sponsor realm and fee collector balances become the one replayed amount recomputed from gas, and they diverge from the source chain once a sponsorship-enabled chain is forked. Latent until such a chain exists.
